integrity.claim_scope: Exact fixed-provision-probability revenue frontier and sharp Gaussian limit under the stated assumptions.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: Earliest verified arXiv public date for arXiv:2101.02423 is 2021-01-07; the later revision date is not used.

scientific_limitations: Independent uniform [0,1] values; binary non-excludable public good; DSIC and ex-post individual rationality.
Budget balance is ex ante. The equality point in the asymptotic frontier has unresolved finite-n lower-order behavior.
The finite-n frontier is a quantile integral, not an elementary closed form.
title: Sharp provision–revenue frontier at the square-root cost scale
